title: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC)
abstract: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) (Version 1.0, 2025-12-08) Introductory Remarks The Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) is a pioneering legal initiative that aims to create a neutral legal frame- work for digital interactions, assets, contracts, dispute resolution and governance, which can adapt to technological changes. The UDLC aims to bridge the gap between the rapidly evolving digital ecosystem and the traditional legal system. This framework ensures enforceability, fairness and procedural
